Privacy

Home / Privacy

The form prepares a WhatsApp message with your name and preferences for you to send. The website does not save this information in its own database. The team receives only what you choose to send on WhatsApp.

Your browser stores your language preference and, when analytics is configured, your consent choice. You can clear these preferences in your browser settings.

Google Analytics loads only when it has been configured and you have agreed. Conversion events do not include your name, message content or phone number.

WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Maps, external font services and weather providers also apply their own privacy policies. Contact the team on WhatsApp with questions about information sent to the school.
